transformations.name: strip_whitespace
transformations.rationale: Removes invisible whitespace to prevent categorical matching failures and type errors.

transformations.name: fix_totalcharges_blanks_and_type
transformations.rationale: Empirical evidence proves all 11 customers with blank TotalCharges have tenure=0 (new registrations prior to first billing cycle). Imputing 0.0 represents physical reality with zero statistical data leakage.

transformations.name: encode_target_binary
transformations.rationale: Maps categorical target to standard binary integer (0=Retained, 1=Churned) required by ML estimators.

transformations.name: drop_identifier_column
transformations.rationale: Unique alphanumeric customer identifier carries 100% cardinality with zero generalizable predictive signal. Dropping prevents high-cardinality leakage and overfitting.
